actions.action: Tap branch over white paper to check for mites
Inspect leaf undersides and stem joints with zoomed phone camera or hand lens for webbing and stippling
Check soil moisture 2-3 inches down with finger
Water thoroughly when top 2 inches are dry and empty saucer
Move plant away from heating/AC vents and drafts
Group with other plants or set up a pebble tray for humidity
If mites confirmed, spray whole plant with insecticidal soap or neem every 5-7 days for about three rounds
Wipe leaves with damp cloth between treatments
Trim brown leaf tips with clean scissors

reason: The answer mainly blames dry conditions and mentions spider mites only as a secondary possibility. Its mite treatment (soap or neem) is conditional and buried, not the systemic that worked. The tap-test check safeguards against seriously delaying treatment.
